wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the cluster nearest to any structures to reduce the amount of continuous vegetation that could carry fire toward the building.
• Separate individual scattered trees from each other and from structures by removing lower branches to reduce the chance that fire moves from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Keep the open terrain areas between scattered trees and structures clear of dry grass and low shrubs.
• Remove dead branches and accumulated debris from beneath scattered trees near the structure.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees close to the structure up to a height of at least 6 to 10 feet from the ground.
